project_context.archetype: 4 (Swiss & High-Contrast utility mixed with organic touch targets)
project_context.core_strategy: Transform a chaotic 20-section vertical scroll into a scannable, hierarchical mobile super-app. Prioritize 'Daily Drivers' at the top, group secondary services into clean bento grids, and consolidate banners into horizontal discovery lanes.

layout_strategy.container: max-w-[430px] mx-auto min-h-screen bg-[#F8FAFC] pb-24 overflow-x-hidden relative shadow-[0_0_40px_rgba(0,0,0,0.05)]
reorganization_plan: 1. STICKY HEADER: Glassmorphism top bar containing User Greeting, Address Pill, and a prominent Search Bar.
2. DAILY DRIVERS (HERO): A 2x2 grid of the 4 absolute most used services (VTC, Food Delivery, Courier, Pharmacy) using distinct, larger tiles.
3. PROMO CAROUSEL: Auto-rotating horizontal banners directly below the hero section for high-value conversions.

4. BENTO GRIDS (THE CORE): Group the remaining 15+ arrays into logical cards (e.g., 'Mobilité & Auto', 'Maison & Dépannage', 'Santé & Bien-être'). Each card contains a standard 4-column internal grid of small tiles.
5. DISCOVERY LANES: Consolidate standalone promotional banners (Real Estate, Parking, Carpool, Genie) into horizontal scrollable sections rather than stacking them vertically.

Header.classes: sticky top-0 z-50 w-full bg-white/85 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-slate-200/60 pt-4 pb-3 px-4 flex flex-col gap-3
Header.structure: Row 1: Flex-between (Left: Avatar + 'Bonjour, User', Right: Notifications). Row 2: Location pill and Search Input (bg-slate-100 rounded-2xl h-12 flex items-center px-4).

PrimaryHeroTile.classes: bg-white p-4 rounded-3xl shadow-sm border border-slate-100 flex flex-col justify-between aspect-square relative overflow-hidden group active:scale-95 transition-transform
PrimaryHeroTile.icon_treatment: Large 32px Phosphor Duotone icon in the top left. Icon color maps to the brand (Primary #FF5000 or Secondary #0B1426).
PrimaryHeroTile.text_treatment: Bottom left alignment, text-sm font-bold text-[#0B1426] leading-tight.
PrimaryHeroTile.background_accent: Subtle #FFF0E5 radial gradient in the bottom right corner to add depth without clutter.

StandardServiceTile.container: flex flex-col items-center gap-2 w-full active:opacity-70 transition-opacity
StandardServiceTile.icon_box: w-[60px] h-[60px] rounded-[20px] flex items-center justify-center bg-slate-50 hover:bg-[#FFF0E5] transition-colors border border-slate-100 shadow-[0_2px_8px_rgba(11,20,38,0.02)]
StandardServiceTile.icon: 28px Phosphor Duotone, default text-[#0B1426], hover/active text-[#FF5000]
StandardServiceTile.label: text-[11px] font-medium text-[#334155] text-center leading-[1.1] line-clamp-2 px-1 w-full

SectionCard.wrapper: bg-white rounded-[28px] p-5 mx-4 mb-5 shadow-[0_4px_20px_-4px_rgba(11,20,38,0.05)] border border-slate-100/80
SectionCard.title: text-lg font-bold text-[#0B1426] tracking-tight

PromoBanner.wrapper: w-full overflow-x-auto snap-x snap-mandatory no-scrollbar flex gap-4 px-4 pb-2
PromoBanner.card: snap-center shrink-0 w-[85%] h-36 rounded-3xl p-5 relative overflow-hidden flex flex-col justify-end

BottomNav.wrapper: fixed bottom-0 z-[60] w-full max-w-[430px] left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 bg-white/90 backdrop-blur-lg border-t border-slate-200/60 pb-safe-bottom h-[72px] flex justify-around items-center px-2
BottomNav.item: flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-1 w-16 h-full

animations.page_load: Framer Motion: initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 20 }}, animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}, transition={{ staggerChildren: 0.05 }}
animations.tap_state: Framer Motion: whileTap={{ scale: 0.94 }} for tiles, buttons, and banners.
animations.carousel: Native CSS scroll-snap-type: x mandatory with no-scrollbar class.

testing.rules: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes formatted as kebab-case role-based strings.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. PRESERVE CMS COMPATIBILITY: The StandardServiceTile MUST accept dynamic icon names (Phosphor string references) and labels as currently structured in the codebase.

2. RESTRUCTURE THE PAGE: Do not just style the vertical list. Wrap the categories into SectionCard components (e.g. group 'Entretien Auto' and 'Dépannage' into a single 'Auto & Mobilité' visual section).
3. MOBILE-FIRST CONSTRAINTS: Wrap the entire UserHome.js root in `max-w-[430px] mx-auto overflow-hidden`.
4. TYPOGRAPHY: Import and use Outfit for headings and Manrope for body text.
5. SCROLLING: Use standard Tailwind classes `overflow-x-auto snap-x snap-mandatory` for carousels. Hide scrollbars using custom CSS or tailwind plugin.
6. ICONS: Standardize on `@phosphor-icons/react` Duotone weight. Set base icon size to 28px in the tiles.
7. TEST IDS: Inject data-testid into every tile mapping loop (e.g., `data-testid={`service-tile-${item.label_fr.toLowerCase()}`}`).
